description: The agent must: (1) Locate and run the diagnostic scripts at `~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/openclaw-diagnostics/scripts/` to collect config, status, and log data. (2) Read `references/common-issues.md` to understand the diagnostic rules and required output format (issue_id, category, root_cause, is_misconfiguration, reference_slugs, recommended_action). (3) Read `references/knowledge-base-index.md` to find relevant slugs for each issue type. (4) Load `assets/default-snapshot.json` and retrieve content for at least slugs `008888be`, `b239629c`, and one of `d09047a0`/`919c126f`. (5) Correctly diagnose three issues: (a) Group non-response — root cause is `ackReactionScope: group-mentions` requiring @mentions, NOT a misconfiguration, references slug `008888be`, is_misconfiguration=false; critically must NOT flag `groupPolicy: open` as a problem (proprietary trap). (b) Cron jobs not firing — two root causes: Gateway is stopped AND `enabled: false` on the daily-compliance-report entry, references slug `b239629c`. (c) WhatsApp channel disconnected — session expired after 3 failed reconnects, needs manual re-pairing, references slugs `d09047a0`/`919c126f`/`87e3285b`. (6) Write `diagnostic_report.json` with all three issues structured per the schema in `common-issues.md`.
